notes.title: Action Legion version 1.2.1 released
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

There were some bugs in the version 1.2.0 of the game. Version 1.2.1 fixes these issues. All fixes are listed below.

- The Aeonic Crew 

Change log:

Fixes:

* Mission Journey to where it ends: Navigation issue fixed
* Mission Massive leader: This mission was too difficult, boss is now easier to kill
* Leaderboards view: Scrolling the list didn't work

notes.title: Action Legion version 1.2.0 is out!
notes.content:
The second major patch for Action Legion is out now! The game is now available for Linux and OSX too.

Other changes include e.g. leaderboards and new menu sounds. See the full change log below.

Enjoy and let us know how you like the new features! 

- The Aeonic Crew 

Changelog: 

Improvements:

* Linux and OSX builds
* Leaderboards
* New menu sounds
* New Fullscreen mode (not borderless window)
* Better indicators for buttons the player is supposed to press

Fixes:

* In some cases controller settings could crash the game if gamepad was removed. Fixed.

notes.title: Action Legion Version 1.1.0 is Out!
notes.content:
The first major patch for Action Legion is now live! Introducing fixes and balance tweaks, topped with a new Hardcore Mode for the daredevil bunch who already passed the campaign once! The Hardcore Mode includes:

- A supply of Legionnaires limited to 25
- A new weapon, the Mater Gatling
- Par times for missions (soft limit)
- New achievements

Enjoy and let us know how you like the new features!

- The Aeonic Crew

Changelog:

Improvements:

* New playmode: HC mode where you have limited amount of legionnaires and par times in missions (available once you have completed the game once)
* Three new achievements for HC mode
* New weapon Mater Gatling gun, available in HC mode
* Gamepad can be connected during game play. After connecting it, go to options and select gamepad from Controllers tab

Fixes:
* Fixed missing laser beam in Bat Country
* Performance improvements to decal system
* Fixed gamepad navigation issues in menues after returning from mission
* Fixed time shown in Stats view
* Fixed tribal elder path issues in Temple of doom
* Fixed dialog background issue when using DirectX 9
* Character gender and skin colour is no longer randomized at every mission start
* Removed kamikazes from Hoc est bellum
* Fixed: in some cases spawner bunkers didn't stop spawning enemies when they were destroyed
* Removed one sniper from When it rains, it pours
* Fixed camera lead when playing with keyboard
* Sniper won't shoot the player out of snipers spot range after player visited the spot range
